reader.requirement: At 85, in DIVIDE formats 4 and 5 the remainder must be dividend minus (subsidiary quotient x divisor), the subsidiary quotient being identifier-3's digits, decimal point and sign presence, unedited and truncated even under ROUNDED (GR6), and the remainder must be stored into identifier-4 (numeric or numeric-edited) with decimal alignment and truncation, never rounding.

edition-consulted.switches: below 2002 an UNSIGNED fixed-point identifier-3 makes the subsidiary quotient its absolute value (§1985:VI.6.11.4 GR6 sign presence); from 2002 the subsidiary is always signed

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel/Edition in ArithmeticEmitter.cs: lines 264 (UnsignedSubsidiary) and 719 (EmitArith UnphrasedSizeErrorIsFatal)
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: with an unsigned identifier-3 and a negative quotient, 85 forms the remainder from the unsigned quotient (DIVIDE -11 BY 3 GIVING PIC 99 REMAINDER gives -20) and 2023 from the signed one (-2)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f04_04 covers truncation of the remainder to fewer decimals, zero-fill to more, and ROUNDED quotient; the probes add numeric-edited remainder and quotient, SIGN SEPARATE, COMP/COMP-3, unsigned identifier-3 and identifier-4 with negative operands, an 18-digit dividend

probes.expected: 1.2345-0.7=0.5345 truncated to .53/.5 (not rounded, no size error for low-order truncation); edited quotient: unedited truncated 0.1 used; ROUNDED 2/3 -> Q 0.7, remainder from 0.6 = 0.2; unsigned id-3 at 85 -> |q|=3, 11-... = -20; 18-digit dividend exact

probes.printed: --std 2023: G 03 -02 / H 03 02, all other lines identical
probes.expected: 2023 uses a signed subsidiary quotient; 1985 keeps identifier-3's sign absence

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.11.4 GR7  (6.11.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR7
OK  §1985:VI.6.11.4 GR6  (6.11.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR6

reader.notes: The remainder is formed exactly (Combine with keepWide) and stored with CobolRounding.Truncation; REMAINDER has no ROUNDED in the grammar. The 1985 sign arm UnsignedSubsidiary is exercised by G/H and differs from 2023 as the editions' texts differ.

refuter.evidence: div7r.cob at --std 85 (runs/div7r-001) vs --std 2023 (runs/div7r-002), DD = -11: unsigned EDITED quotient PIC Z9 -> R -020 at 85 (subsidiary |q|=3) and -002 at 2023; signed edited -9 and 9CR -> -002 at both (PicInfo.HoldsSign reads +,-,CR,DB in the mask); P-scaled 99P: 157/1 -> Q 150, R +007; VPP9: 1/997 -> .001, R +.00300; unsigned ROUNDED: Q 4, R -020 (subsidiary truncated, not rounded); unsigned COMP-3 and COMP quotient -> -020; unsigned remainder 999 -> 020; signed ROUNDED -7/2 -> Q -4, R -001. All match GR6's intermediate field and GR7's truncation. cites: OK  §1985:VI.6.11.4 GR7  (6.11.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR7; OK  §1985:VI.6.11.4 GR6  (6.11.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR6.
